NEW: Hezbollah still has 11k-12k rockets/missiles in their arsenal. 5.5k-6k are considered in the range of Israel, two Israeli intelligence officials tell Fox News.

Hezbollah has roughly 1/5 of their pre-war firepower, including hundreds of medium-range missiles that could target civilian population areas in central Israel.

“They are actually trying to increase their capabilities. Both in the fire capabilities with rockets and rocket launchers, and ground units that they still have," one Israeli intelligence official added.

CENTCOM Update 

TAMPA, Fla. – As of 7:30 am ET, March 2, four U.S. service members have been killed in action. The fourth service member, who was seriously wounded during Iran’s initial attacks, eventually succumbed to their injuries. 

Major combat operations continue and our response effort is ongoing.

The identities of the fallen are being withheld until 24 hours after next of kin notification.
